description: Blacksmith's anvil, London pattern, about 0.62 m: long tapered horn to +X flowing out of a lower step, flat hardened face with dressed, chipped edges and a forge-weld seam, heel to -X with a square hardy hole and a round pritchel hole, narrow waist, wide base with four feet and arched cut-outs. Hand-forged body with hammer dents, black scale, rust in recesses, polished wear on the face, horn top and working edges.
